book.name: 2 Korid
book.title: 2 Korid Pol köp hain u Korid nɨbi bɨ kalɨp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Pol, “Nɨbi bɨ Krais lau adö mɨdpal gau ud aij gɨmim,” a ga
Pen Krais nɨbi bɨ nɨpe Jerusalem mɨdpal gau mani ñɨmim, a gabin manö u, yɨharɨŋ hagpin; kale ke nɨŋ aij gɨpim.

Kale Akaia Propins mɨdpim gau, mɨ nöd u, mani kale ñɨnɨg gaibe u, yad nɨbi bɨ Masedonia Propins mɨdpal gau kalɨp rapɨn hagem hagmɨdin. Kale Akaia nɨbi bɨ ñɨnɨg gaibe u, Masedonia kai kalɨp manö hagnö, uri nɨbi bɨ iru nöp gasɨ nɨŋ aij göm mani kale ñaböl.
Pen mam hon uri hagajɨn gau kalöp hag yuabin u, kale mani kale God nɨp ñeb u ud lɨ aij gɨmim gɨ jɨn gɨ mɨdpe, Masedonia nɨbi bɨ gau, Pol manö nöp hagöp a göm hagagöl, a gem kalɨp yuabin.
Kale mani lɨ magum gɨ aij gagnabim u, Masedonia nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap uɫ gɨ Korid amjakno, hanɨp nable gɨnab. Pen kalöp nable yabɨƚ gɨnɨm rö löp.
Anɨb u, mam hon gau kalɨp nöd hag yuabin. Kale am kalöp aip mɨdlö, mani ñɨnabun a gɨpe u, lɨ magum gɨpe mɨdainɨm. Hainö yad amjaknabin u, kale ñɨñɨ löl gɨ mani ñɨnabim anɨbu gɨ jɨn gɨ mɨdeinab.
Kale nɨŋbim, nɨbi bɨ nan yɨŋ iru yɨmagnaböl gau, nan iru udagnaböl; nɨbi bɨ nan yɨŋ iru yɨmnaböl gau nöp, nan iru nöp udnaböl.

Anɨb u, kale nɨbi bɨ añɨ añɨ mɨdpim rö, gasɨ kale ke nɨŋmim mani ñɨmim. Iru gö nɨŋöl gɨ ñagmim. Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalöp neb neb gɨlö nɨŋmim, ñagmim. Bɨ mɨñ mɨñ göm mani ñɨnab u, God bɨ anɨbu nɨp mɨdmagö löp.
God nɨpe nan aij kalöp ñɨnɨg gab u, nan pro ñagnab; rapɨn nöp ñɨnab rö löp. Anɨb u, pör nöp kale ke nan iru mɨdeinab nɨŋöm nɨbi bɨ mani uƚep löp gau nan iru ñɨmim rö lɨnab.
Adö anɨbu rö, God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla,

content.text: “Nɨpe nɨbi bɨ mög gep gau kalɨp nan aij abönamö ñɨnab.
Nɨpe pör nöp kalɨp ud aij göm gɨ aij gɨnab,” a gɨla.

content: God hanɨp pör nan yɨŋ ñöm, nan magö ñöm göp u, kalöp nan yɨŋ iru yabɨƚ ñɨnab. Pen nɨpe gö ran aij geinab nɨŋöm kale udmim rɨmnap nɨbi bɨ nan uƚep löp gau nɨme lɨ ñɨbe me, aij yabɨƚ gɨnɨm rö löp. Mani nan kale ñɨnabim u, God nɨpe gö nan magö iru yabɨƚ nöp pɨlnab.
Kalöp pör gö, nan kale iru nöp mɨdö, haƚöwaƚö ñeb rö lɨnab u me, nan ñöl gɨ mɨdpe, hon damun Krais nɨbi bɨ Jerusalem mɨdpal gau dam ñɨno, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp God hib nɨpe haglö adö arnab.
Anɨg gɨmim, Krais nɨbi bɨ nan uƚep göp gau kalɨp gɨ aij gɨnabim u, kale nan uƚep göp anɨbu udöm mɨd aij göm God hib nɨpe haglö adö arnab.

Anɨg gɨpe, nɨbi bɨ gau kale God nɨp gasɨ nɨŋöm hagnaböl, “Krais nɨbi bɨ nɨpe Korid mɨdpal gau, kale Krais manö aij u udöm, hagöp rö nöp göm, hanɨp mani abönamö ñöm, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp abönamö ñöm gɨpal u, nöp aij yabɨƚ a gabun,” a gɨnaböl.
God kalöp mög nɨŋöm ud aij yabɨƚ göp rö nɨŋöm, gasɨ kale am kalöp wam wam gö aij gö nɨŋöl gɨ, kalöp nan a göm God nɨp sabe gɨnaböl.
God nɨpe nan aij unbö ke hanɨp ñöb u rö, nɨp aij göp a gun me!
